title: Seamless end-to-end containerized HPC environments
problem: HPC environments struggle with conflicting demands: stability, customization, and reproducibility; traditional monolithic software stacks are inflexible
motivation: Diverse scientific workflows require different software configurations; reproducibility and portability are critical for scientific computing
method: Decompose containerization into five areas: environment specification/construction (Spack+CI/CD), session provisioning (PAM+Kubernetes), scheduler integration (Slurm native), system integration, security; develop and evaluate prototypes
key_novelty: Comprehensive end-to-end containerization framework using open standards for seamless HPC environment management without sacrificing UX
contributions: Spack-based environment construction with CI/CD pipelines
Transparent session provisioning via PAM and Kubernetes
Holistic containerization framework for HPC environments
limitations: Security aspects not fully detailed in abstract; scalability on very large heterogeneous systems not discussed
primary_theme: HPC software environment containerization and reproducibility
